recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of a man with a high-top fade haircut, wearing a black jacket adorned with large gold medallions, set against a warm, mottled brown studio backdrop with collage-style typographic overlays.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third, looking toward the viewer
Text elements floating on the left side over a vertical abstract squiggle
Warm brown background tones contrasting with the cool teal of the text
High-contrast lighting emphasizing the texture of the gold jewelry and skin
coreInvariants: High-top fade hairstyle with sharp geometric edges
Multiple rows of large, circular gold medallions on the jacket lapel
Mottled, painterly studio backdrop in earth tones
Text appearing as if cut from white paper strips

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, subject occupies the right 60% of the frame, angled slightly away from the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright gold medallions on the lapel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down the gold medallions, then across to the vertical text elements on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant breathing room on the left side, filled with abstract graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the jacket providing a solid base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright gold for the jewelry and teal/cyan for the lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white paper strips and the dark jacket; saturated gold highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase letters for the first word, uppercase for the second
Placed on slightly rotated white rectangular strips
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with case variation for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Vertical, hand-drawn organic squiggle in dark brown/black

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the era's specific geometric sans-serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a Black man with a sharp high-top fade haircut and a thin mustache, wearing a black blazer with multiple rows of large, ornate gold medallions on the lapel. The background should be a mottled, warm brown studio backdrop with soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two white rectangular strips in the top left, rotated slightly counter-clockwise. On the top strip, place lowercase teal geometric sans-serif text with wide tracking. On the bottom strip, place uppercase teal geometric sans-serif text with wide tracking. Add a vertical, dark brown organic hand-drawn squiggle behind the strips.

verificationChecks: Is the haircut a sharp, flat-topped fade?
Are the gold medallions prominent and circular?
Is the text teal on white strips?

adjustableVariables: Rotation angle of the text strips
Color of the text (teal vs other 80s neon)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Exact shape of the background squiggle
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text tracking is wide enough to feel airy.
Check that the gold medallions have a metallic sheen.
Verify the high-top fade has a distinct, flat upper surface.
Confirm the white strips look like physical paper overlays.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + High-Top Fade + Gold Medallion Jacket + Mottled Backdrop + Paper Strip Typography
